title: WhatsApp links for approved view-only phone sharing
summary: Adds an HTTPS invitation handoff, a WhatsApp composer action, a received-link fallback and clear approval instructions. Website publication and updated Android installation are required before public use.

changes.detail: Normal HTTPS WhatsApp link with invitation credential in its fragment, localized landing page, explicit package-bound Android app launch, manual copy fallback and no analytics or API calls on the landing page.
Send through WhatsApp opens the composer, falls back to the share sheet, displays expiry countdown and explains returning to Learn; copying gives confirmation.
Paste a received HTTPS or legacy app invitation inside Learn, with exact-origin validation and existing explicit approval flow.
Exclude invitation routes from saved navigation history.

validation.name: Automated checks
validation.detail: TypeScript, focused lint, handoff/interaction/regression and history checks pending.

validation.name: Public and physical availability
validation.detail: Not deployed and not installed. The public landing files must be published on lecomax.com; both phones require updated Learn, sign-in and Tailscale. Actual WhatsApp launch and live two-phone capture remain untested.
